events.evidence: Mexican President Enrique Peña Nieto cancels a scheduled trip to the United States after a heated phone call with U.S. President Donald Trump
French President Emmanuel Macron phones Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, telling Erdoğan that the UN-approved ceasefire in Syria also applies in the Afrin Region
United States Special Representative for North Korea Policy Joseph Y. Yun announces his retirement, effective 2 March

label.note: Mexico-US tension, Syria/Afrin diplomacy, North Korea envoy exit; mild geopolitical uncertainty.
